mentions.name: Michigan Pulse
mentions.description: A community-driven directory aggregating technology resources for Michigan, such as tech companies hiring talent, university programs, and incubators. It includes a newsletter that is already live, and is currently in beta while gathering starting data and feedback.
mentions.source_excerpt: I just launched the beta of my app that uses Elixir/Phoenix. Its a community driven aggregation of technology resources for Michigan, like companies in Michigan that hire tech talent, university programs, incubators in Michigan, etc. It also includes a newsletter thats already fully live and has over 10 subscribers.
